audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 phase is generic filler and never explains why Malphite is given the stage.
audit.why: Infected Bonesaw costs Mundo health on every cast and Heart Zapper does not exist yet, so the earliest levels are the only ones where his sustain engine is not running.
audit.corrected: Level 1 now states the health cost and the 625-range Seismic Shard pattern.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase says Unstoppable Force is a win button without noting that Mundo's passive blanks it.
audit.why: Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilizing effect and drops a cannister instead, so the knock-up is absorbed unless the passive is already spent.
audit.corrected: Level 6 phase now sequences the ult behind popping the cannister.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction of the matchup — Mundo's passive eating the first hard CC, including your Unstoppable Force knock-up — is never stated anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot's description of Goes Where He Pleases: he resists the first Immobilizing effect that hits him, losing Health and dropping a cannister. Malphite's entire kill setup is one knock-up.
audit.corrected: Passive interaction added to the Level 6 phase, the ult spike, the level-6 why and the Key Ability Interactions block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block lists no numbers at all.
audit.why: Heart Zapper is 17s at rank 1, Infected Bonesaw only 4s, Blunt Force Trauma 9s at rank 1 and Maximum Dosage 120s — the poke is unpunishable, the sustain is not.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into the cooldown breakdown and the first Do.

audit.whatIsWrong: The anti-heal Don't repeats the passive-shield trade line instead of saying anything about healing.
audit.why: Heart Zapper and Maximum Dosage are both heals; Grievous Wounds has to be applied before the extended fight starts.
audit.corrected: Don't rewritten to name both heal sources and the timing.

edits.before: Q-poke wins level 1 and the move-speed steal compounds. Identify how Dr. Mundo contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Infected Bonesaw costs him health every 4s cast and Heart Zapper is not online yet. Seismic Shard him from 625 and leave on the stolen speed.

edits.before: Unstoppable Force is a teamfight win button — the lane is just where you bank it. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Dr. Mundo's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is your win button, but Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilizing effect — spend his cannister first or the knock-up is absorbed.

edits.before: - Dr. Mundo Heart Zapper: matchup-defining — His sustain + reset. Anti-heal it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heart Zapper (W): 17s at rank 1 — his stored-damage heal, anti-heal before it ends. - Infected Bonesaw (Q): 4s, costs him health — unpunishable, stop chasing it. - Maximum Dosage (R): 120s. - Your ultimate: 130s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Dr. Mundo's Heart Zapper: His sustain + reset. Anti-heal it. When it is down — R-W-E him.
edits.after: Goes Where He Pleases (P) resists the first immobilizing effect — pop it before you spend your ultimate.

edits.before: His sustain + reset. Anti-heal it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His stored-damage heal, 17s at rank 1. Apply Grievous Wounds before it expires.

edits.before: Trading with your passive shield down — that shield IS your trade margin; without it you are paying full price.
edits.after: Heart Zapper and Maximum Dosage both heal — Grievous Wounds goes on before the extended fight, not partway through.

edits.before: Unstoppable Force (R) is your one swing window — knock him up and chain E plus W for a gank setup, the only thing here he can't simply heal through.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force (R) is your one swing window, but his passive resists the first immobilizing effect — bait the cannister, then knock him up for your jungler.

edits.before: Even — Unstoppable Force is my one tool Mundo can't heal through, so I R to knock him up and set up a gank, the single window I genuinely contest.
edits.after: Even — Unstoppable Force is the one tool he cannot heal through, but his passive eats the first immobilizing effect, so spend the cannister before the knock-up.

notes: Malphite kit file flags 'grounding' on Seismic Shard and Ground Slam; Riot's descriptions say move-speed steal and attack-speed reduction only, so no grounding claim was written.
